title: The Office - Presentation Series 6 - Addressing the Audience
audio: mp3/286. The Office - Presentation Series 6 - Addressing the Audience.mp3

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we have the continuation of our series about giving a presentation.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们继续我们的关于演讲的系列。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today it's part six and on this occasion we're going to address the audience.
segments.zh: 今天是第六部分，这次我们将向观众发表讲话。

segments.en: So we're going to talk to the audience and explain a couple of things.
segments.zh: 所以我们将与观众交谈并解释一些事情。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to today's speech and we'll be back in a moment to talk about what's going on.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听今天的演讲，我们稍后会回来谈论正在发生的事情。

segments.en: The campaign that we have in store for the X420 is exciting, imaginative and revolutionary.
segments.zh: 我们为 X420 准备的活动令人兴奋、富有想象力和革命性。

segments.en: We have spent two years listening to and responding to feedback from customers and staff alike.
segments.zh: 我们花了两年时间倾听和回应客户和员工的反馈。

segments.en: I'd like to say that without the assistance and support of each and every one of you, we really could not have devised this campaign.
segments.zh: 我想说，没有在座每一位的帮助和支持，我们确实无法策划出这次推广活动。

segments.en: I'd like to take my hat off and really thank you all for the wonderful work you've done so far, not only in helping support our marketing efforts, but also in continuing your commitment to alpha computers.
segments.zh: 我向大家致敬，也衷心感谢各位迄今的出色工作：你们不仅支持了营销工作，也始终为 Alpha 电脑公司尽心尽力。

segments.en: There's no doubt in my mind that we have a great workforce here and together we can really push alpha computers to a whole new level of success.
segments.zh: 毫无疑问，我们在这里拥有一支强大的员工队伍，我们可以一起真正将 Alpha 计算机推向全新的成功水平。

segments.en: On the subject of the campaign, let me ask you all a question.
segments.zh: 关于活动的主题，让我问大家一个问题。

segments.en: How do we define the perfect laptop?
segments.zh: 我们如何定义完美的笔记本电脑？

segments.en: Is it about affordability, quality, speed, reliability?
segments.zh: 是关于可负担性、质量、速度、可靠性吗？

segments.en: What do you look for in a consumer?
segments.zh: 你作为消费者，会看重什么？

segments.en: Well, I believe the answer lies in a combination of all of these elements.
segments.zh: 好吧，我相信答案在于所有这些元素的组合。

segments.en: Our campaign will really hammer home the point that the X420 is a state-of-the-art laptop for all of your computing needs.
segments.zh: 我们的活动将真正强调 X420 是一款最先进的笔记本电脑，以满足您的所有计算需求。

segments.en: With our television campaign, we hope to really reach out to a huge audience.
segments.zh: 通过我们的电视活动，我们希望真正接触到大量观众。

segments.en: We have a great ad campaign planned, focused on the fantastic USPs of the X420.
segments.zh: 我们策划了一场精彩的广告活动，重点突出 X420 的独特卖点。

segments.en: We've hired one of the best PR companies to work with us on the campaign and have already completed three separate TV adverts, all focusing on one key feature of the X420.
segments.zh: 我们聘请了最好的公关公司之一与我们合作开展该活动，并且已经完成了三个独立的电视广告，所有这些广告都专注于 X420 的一个关键功能。

segments.en: I'm excited to say that today for the first time we will unveil to all of you here the first of these advertisements.
segments.zh: 我很高兴地说，今天我们将在这里向大家展示这些广告中的第一个。

segments.en: All right, we're back and now let's take a look at five key words on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了，现在让我们来看看语言要点的五个关键词。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: All right, so first up, Marco, we have a verb.
segments.zh: 好吧，首先，马可，我们有一个动词。

segments.en: The verb is to devise.
segments.zh: 这个动词是 devise。

segments.en: That's right, so we devised a campaign.
segments.zh: 没错，所以我们设计了一个活动。

segments.en: Okay, so to devise in this case means to create or to come up with.
segments.zh: 好的，所以 to devise 在这里的意思是创造或想出。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: I think in many movies you will hear that someone will devise a plan to destroy the world for example.
segments.zh: 我想在许多电影中，你会听到有人会设计一个摧毁世界的计划。

segments.en: Right, or to devise a scheme.
segments.zh: 正确，或设计方案。

segments.en: So that's to create or to come up with a plan or come up with something.
segments.zh: 所以那是创建或提出计划或想出一些东西。

segments.en: And talking about the computers, he mentioned a couple of words that describe it, especially the affordability of the laptop computer.
segments.zh: 谈到电脑，他提到了几个描述它的词，尤其是笔记本电脑的可负担性。

segments.en: Okay, so yeah, there's this string of nouns that Mr. Ford thinks are very important relating to the perfect laptop.
segments.zh: 好吧，是的，福特先生认为这一串名词对一台完美的笔记本电脑来说非常重要。

segments.en: And in this case, affordability is the first one.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，负担能力是第一个。

segments.en: So something that is affordable is something that you can have the money to buy.
segments.zh: 所以负担得起的东西是你可以有钱买的东西。

segments.en: It's not too expensive.
segments.zh: 它不太贵。

segments.en: That's the adjective affordable.
segments.zh: 这是形容词负担得起的。

segments.en: Affordability means whether or not something is expensive.
segments.zh: Affordability 指的是某样东西的价格是否让人负担得起。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So if you think of the adjective affordable, the noun would be affordability.
segments.zh: 所以，形容词 affordable 对应的名词就是 affordability。

segments.en: So this is just the way that you can transform an adjective into a noun.
segments.zh: 所以这只是你可以将形容词转换为名词的方式。

segments.en: Right, so this is something that comes up a lot when we're talking about buying things.
segments.zh: 是的，所以当我们谈论购买东西时，这会经常出现。

segments.en: For example, Marco, I could say, what do you look for when you're buying a car?
segments.zh: 例如，马可，我可以说，你买车的时候会寻找什么？

segments.en: Right, so I can say affordability.
segments.zh: 对，所以我可以说负担能力。

segments.en: And you could also say our next one, which is reliability.
segments.zh: 你也可以说我们的下一个，即可靠性。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So if you look for a car, you are also looking for reliability.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您寻找汽车，您也在寻找可靠性。

segments.en: And this comes from the adjective reliable.
segments.zh: 它来自形容词 reliable。

segments.en: All right, so something is reliable if you can depend on it.
segments.zh: 好吧，如果你能依赖它，有些东西是可靠的。

segments.en: It means, you know, in the case of a laptop or a car, it won't break easily.
segments.zh: 这意味着，您知道，在笔记本电脑或汽车的情况下，它不会轻易损坏。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Or a person can also be reliable.
segments.zh: 或者一个人也可以是可靠的。

segments.en: You can trust that person to help you, for example.
segments.zh: 例如，您可以相信该人会帮助您。

segments.en: Or I can trust that he'll never be late or never forget that we have an appointment.
segments.zh: 或者我可以相信他永远不会迟到或永远不会忘记我们有约会。

segments.en: That's exactly right.
segments.zh: 完全正确。

segments.en: Well, moving on to the next part of Mr. Ford's speech, he talked about the television campaign and how he really hopes to reach out to a huge audience with this television advert.
segments.zh: 好吧，继续讨论福特先生演讲的下一部分，他谈到了电视活动，以及他如何真正希望通过这个电视广告接触到大量的观众。

segments.en: All right, so the reason we've chosen this is because it's important to remember this as a phrase to reach out to.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们选择这个的原因是因为重要的是要记住这是一个可以接触到的短语。

segments.en: That means to connect with.
segments.zh: 这意味着连接。

segments.en: And I think your example of television is a really great one because television allows people to reach out to many, many, many people.
segments.zh: 我认为你的电视例子真的很棒，因为电视可以让人们接触到很多很多很多人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Also, for example, with Internet, you are able to reach out to many people all over the world.
segments.zh: 此外，例如，通过互联网，您可以接触到世界各地的许多人。

segments.en: So, to reach out to is to connect with.
segments.zh: 所以，接触就是连接。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And for our last word, when he was about to show everyone the TV advert, he said that tonight for the first time we will unveil the first of these advertisements.
segments.zh: 最后一个词，当他即将向大家展示电视广告时，他说今晚我们将第一次公开这些广告中的第一个。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So, to unveil something is actually very exciting because to unveil something is to show it for the very first time.
segments.zh: 所以，unveil 某样东西其实非常令人兴奋，因为 unveil 就是第一次把它展示出来。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So, maybe you've seen in car shows where they have a car under a big white sheet.
segments.zh: 所以，也许你在车展上看到过他们在一张大白床单下有一辆车。

segments.en: And on that night, they're going to unveil the new model of the, I don't know, the Ford car.
segments.zh: 那天晚上，他们将推出新车型，我不知道，福特汽车。

segments.en: So, that's what it means, to unveil, to take away this veil and show everyone.
segments.zh: 所以，这就是揭开面纱并向所有人展示的意义。

segments.en: To unveil.
segments.zh: 揭幕；首次公开。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So, a lot of good key words there.
segments.zh: 所以，那里有很多好的关键词。

segments.en: Why don't we go back and listen to Mr. Ford again?
segments.zh: 我们为什么不回去再听福特先生的话？

segments.en: And when we return, we'll talk about Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 当我们回来时，我们将谈论流利表达。

segments.en: The campaign that we have in store for the X420 is exciting, imaginative, and revolutionary.
segments.zh: 我们为 X420 准备的活动令人兴奋、富有想象力和革命性。

segments.en: We have spent two years listening to and responding to feedback from customers and staff alike.
segments.zh: 我们花了两年时间倾听和回应客户和员工的反馈。

segments.en: I'd like to say that without the assistance and support of each and every one of you, we really could not have devised this campaign.
segments.zh: 我想说，没有在座每一位的帮助和支持，我们确实无法策划出这次推广活动。

segments.en: I'd like to take my hat off and really thank you all for the wonderful work you've done so far, not only in helping support our marketing efforts, but also in continuing your commitment to Alpha Computers.
segments.zh: 我想脱帽向各位致敬，衷心感谢你们迄今为止所做的出色工作，你们不仅在帮助支持我们的营销工作，而且在继续为 Alpha Computers 尽心尽力。

segments.en: There's no doubt in my mind that we have a great workforce here and together we can really push Alpha Computers to a whole new level of success.
segments.zh: 毫无疑问，我们在这里拥有一支强大的员工队伍，我们可以一起真正将 Alpha 计算机推向全新的成功水平。

segments.en: On the subject of the campaign, let me ask you all a question.
segments.zh: 关于活动的主题，让我问大家一个问题。

segments.en: How do we define the perfect laptop?
segments.zh: 我们如何定义完美的笔记本电脑？

segments.en: Is it about affordability, quality, speed, reliability?
segments.zh: 是关于可负担性、质量、速度、可靠性吗？

segments.en: What do you look for in a consumer?
segments.zh: 您作为消费者，会看重什么？

segments.en: Well, I believe the answer lies in a combination of all of these elements.
segments.zh: 好吧，我相信答案在于所有这些元素的组合。

segments.en: Our campaign will really hammer home the point that the X420 is a state-of-the-art laptop for all of your computing needs.
segments.zh: 我们的活动将真正强调 X420 是一款最先进的笔记本电脑，以满足您的所有计算需求。

segments.en: With our television campaign, we hope to really reach out to a huge audience.
segments.zh: 通过我们的电视活动，我们希望真正接触到大量观众。

segments.en: We have a great ad campaign planned, focused on the fantastic USPs of the X420.
segments.zh: 我们策划了一场精彩的广告活动，重点突出 X420 的独特卖点。

segments.en: We've hired one of the best PR companies to work with us on the campaign and have already completed three separate TV adverts, all focusing on one key feature of the X420.
segments.zh: 我们聘请了最好的公关公司之一与我们合作开展该活动，并且已经完成了三个独立的电视广告，所有这些广告都专注于 X420 的一个关键功能。

segments.en: I'm excited to say that today for the first time, we will unveil to all of you here the first of these advertisements.
segments.zh: 我很高兴地说，今天，我们将在这里向大家展示这些广告中的第一个。

segments.en: Alright we're back, so now let's take a look at these four key phrases we've picked out for you today.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了，现在让我们来看看我们今天为您挑选的这四个关键短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: So in the beginning, Mr. Ford is talking about this exciting X420 and he says that, you know, he would like to say that without the help of each and every one of you, the campaign could not have been created.
segments.zh: 所以一开始，福特先生正在谈论这款令人兴奋的 X420，他说，你知道，他想说，如果没有你们每个人的帮助，这个活动就不可能被创建。

segments.en: So each and every one of you.
segments.zh: 所以你们每一个人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: This is just a phrase where you emphasize that everyone helped you or that you are thanking everyone.
segments.zh: 这只是一个短语，您强调每个人都帮助了您或您感谢每个人。

segments.en: So in a speech, you can say, I want to thank each and every one of you.
segments.zh: 所以在一次演讲中，你可以说，我要感谢你们每一个人。

segments.en: So I want to thank everyone is basically what you're saying.
segments.zh: 所以你基本上就是在说，我要感谢每一个人。

segments.en: And it's, it's interesting because it's kind of like you're saying every single person was important.
segments.zh: 它很有趣，因为这有点像你说每个人都很重要。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's not just like, Hey guys, thank you.
segments.zh: 所以这不只是，嘿，伙计们，谢谢。

segments.en: It's like, no, thank you.
segments.zh: 就像，不，谢谢。

segments.en: And you and you and you.
segments.zh: 还有你、你和你。

segments.en: So each and every one of you, it really emphasizes that each person has helped.
segments.zh: 所以你们每个人，都强调每个人都提供了帮助。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And it's a really nice way of, for example, thanking someone saying, I want to thank each and every one of you.
segments.zh: 这是一种非常好的方式，例如，感谢某人说，我要感谢你们每一个人。

segments.en: It sounds a lot more personal.
segments.zh: 这听起来更个人化。

segments.en: Definitely.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And he also used another very interesting phrase when he said, I'd like to take my hat off and really thank you all for your wonderful work.
segments.zh: 他还用了一个非常有趣的短语，他说：我想脱帽向各位致敬，衷心感谢大家的出色工作。

segments.en: So this makes me think of a person actually back when people used to wear hats every day, taking his hat off and maybe bowing.
segments.zh: 这让我想起，以前人们每天都戴帽子，会摘下帽子，也许还会鞠躬。

segments.en: This is something that used to be very polite because you know, when you meet someone or you want to thank someone, you take your hat off as a sign of respect.
segments.zh: 这曾经是非常有礼貌的事情，因为你知道，当你遇到某人或你想感谢某人时，你就脱下帽子作为尊重的标志。

segments.en: Well we don't wear hats anymore, so it seems a little funny, but we still say this.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们不再戴帽子了，所以看起来有点好笑，但我们仍然这么说。

segments.en: I want to take my hat off to Marco.
segments.zh: 我想向 Marco 脱帽致敬。

segments.en: That means I want to thank you.
segments.zh: 这意味着我要感谢你。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you're showing respect and you're also showing admiration maybe for someone.
segments.zh: 所以你表现出尊重，你也表达了对某人的钦佩。

segments.en: So maybe if you meet somebody who saved someone's life, you would say, I really want to take my hat off and thank you for the work that you've done.
segments.zh: 所以也许如果你遇到一个救了某人生命的人，你会说，我真的很想摘下帽子，感谢你所做的工作。

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: You're impressed.
segments.zh: 你印象深刻。

segments.en: You respect that person who saved that life and you want to thank them for their good deed.
segments.zh: 你尊重那个拯救了生命的人，你要感谢他们的善行。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Well, moving on, when he continued to talk about Alpha Computers and the marketing efforts, he said, there's no doubt in my mind that we have a great workforce.
segments.zh: 好吧，继续前进，当他继续谈论 Alpha 计算机和营销工作时，他说，毫无疑问，我们拥有一支强大的员工队伍。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So another way to say this is, I definitely think we have a great workforce.
segments.zh: 所以另一种说法是，我绝对认为我们有一支优秀的劳动力。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You know, maybe not.
segments.zh: 你知道，也许不是。

segments.en: It's not as interesting, right?
segments.zh: 没那么有趣吧？

segments.en: So we're making this more interesting by using a very colorful phrase and to say, there's no doubt that you're a great workforce is good, but there's no doubt in my mind means there's absolutely no way that I could doubt this.
segments.zh: 所以我们用一个很生动的说法让这话更有意思。说 there's no doubt that you're a great workforce 也不错，但 there's no doubt in my mind 意思是，我对此绝对没有丝毫怀疑。

segments.en: I absolutely believe that you are the best workforce.
segments.zh: 我绝对相信你是最好的劳动力。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, and you can use it with anything.
segments.zh: 所以，你可以将它与任何东西一起使用。

segments.en: You can say, there's no doubt in my mind, IBM computers are the best computers out there, for example.
segments.zh: 你可以说，毫无疑问，在我看来，IBM 计算机是最好的计算机，例如。

segments.en: Or there's no doubt in my mind that the Yankees will win the World Series next year.
segments.zh: 或者毫无疑问，洋基队明年将赢得世界大赛。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's the way that you can use it.
segments.zh: 所以这就是你可以使用它的方式。

segments.en: You're basically telling people that you are very, very sure.
segments.zh: 你基本上是在告诉人们你非常非常确定。

segments.en: And what about our last phrase?
segments.zh: 最后一个短语是什么呢？

segments.en: The very interesting one when he says, our campaign will really hammer home the point.
segments.zh: 非常有意思的一个短语，他说：我们的宣传活动将真正把这一点讲透。

segments.en: Okay, well, you can make a point.
segments.zh: 好吧，你可以提出一个观点。

segments.en: You can say, listen, our computers are state of the art and they're the best for your needs.
segments.zh: 你可以说，听着，我们的电脑是最先进的，它们是最适合您需求的。

segments.en: But to hammer home the point means to really emphasize this one important point and to say, listen, you will never forget this.
segments.zh: 但要强调这一点意味着真正强调这一点，并说，听着，你永远不会忘记这一点。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: You will not forget what I'm going to say to you.
segments.zh: 你不会忘记我要对你说的话。

segments.en: So you really emphasize it and restate it.
segments.zh: 所以你真的很强调它并重述它。

segments.en: This is something that can be frustrating when you're a consumer, when you're watching an advertisement because you hear them say, this is the best product.
segments.zh: 当你作为消费者看广告时，这一点可能会让你很烦，因为你听到他们说，这是最好的产品。

segments.en: You shouldn't buy other products.
segments.zh: 你不应该买其他产品。

segments.en: This is the best product.
segments.zh: 这是最好的产品。

segments.en: And they're hammering home the point.
segments.zh: 他们正在反复强调这一点。

segments.en: They're repeating this message.
segments.zh: 他们正在重复此消息。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's a colloquial phrase that you can use to really, again, put your point across.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个口语短语，你可以用它来真正表达你的观点。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a lot of interesting phrases there.
segments.zh: 所以那里有很多有趣的短语。

segments.en: Why don't we take a break and let's listen to our dialogue again and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不休息一下，让我们再听一次我们的对话，我们会回来的。

segments.en: The campaign that we have in store for the X420 is exciting, imaginative, and revolutionary.
segments.zh: 我们为 X420 准备的活动令人兴奋、富有想象力和革命性。

segments.en: We have spent two years listening to and responding to feedback from customers and staff alike.
segments.zh: 我们花了两年时间倾听和回应客户和员工的反馈。

segments.en: I'd like to say that without the assistance and support of each and every one of you, we really could not have devised this campaign.
segments.zh: 我想说，没有在座每一位的帮助和支持，我们确实无法策划出这次推广活动。

segments.en: I'd like to take my hat off and really thank you all for the wonderful work you've done so far, not only in helping support our marketing efforts, but also in continuing your commitment to alpha computers.
segments.zh: 我向大家致敬，也衷心感谢各位迄今的出色工作：你们不仅支持了营销工作，也始终为 Alpha 电脑公司尽心尽力。

segments.en: There's no doubt in my mind that we have a great workforce here and together we can really push alpha computers to a whole new level of success.
segments.zh: 毫无疑问，我们在这里拥有一支强大的员工队伍，我们可以一起真正将 Alpha 计算机推向全新的成功水平。

segments.en: On the subject of the campaign, let me ask you all a question.
segments.zh: 关于活动的主题，让我问大家一个问题。

segments.en: How do we define the perfect laptop?
segments.zh: 我们如何定义完美的笔记本电脑？

segments.en: Is it about affordability, quality, speed, reliability?
segments.zh: 是关于可负担性、质量、速度、可靠性吗？

segments.en: What do you look for in a consumer?
segments.zh: 您作为消费者，会看重什么？

segments.en: Well, I believe the answer lies in a combination of all of these elements.
segments.zh: 好吧，我相信答案在于所有这些元素的组合。

segments.en: Our campaign will really hammer home the point that the X420 is a state-of-the-art laptop for all of your computing needs.
segments.zh: 我们的活动将真正强调 X420 是一款最先进的笔记本电脑，以满足您的所有计算需求。

segments.en: With our television campaign, we hope to really reach out to a huge audience.
segments.zh: 通过我们的电视活动，我们希望真正接触到大量观众。

segments.en: We have a great ad campaign planned, focused on the fantastic USPs of the X420.
segments.zh: 我们策划了一场精彩的广告活动，重点突出 X420 的独特卖点。

segments.en: We've hired one of the best PR companies to work with us on the campaign and have already completed three separate TV adverts, all focusing on one key feature of the X420.
segments.zh: 我们聘请了最好的公关公司之一与我们合作开展该活动，并且已经完成了三个独立的电视广告，所有这些广告都专注于 X420 的一个关键功能。

segments.en: I'm excited to say that today for the first time we will unveil to all of you here the first of these advertisements.
segments.zh: 我很高兴地说，今天我们将在这里向大家展示这些广告中的第一个。

segments.en: All right, so this was part six of our presentation series.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是我们演示系列的第六部分。

segments.en: We still have four more lessons to go all about this, and they're going to get a little bit more complicated, and we're going to continue talking.
segments.zh: 关于这个主题我们还有四课，这些课会稍微复杂一些，我们会继续讲。

segments.en: The next couple of lessons are actually answering questions from the public and many things like this.
segments.zh: 接下来的几节课实际上是在回答公众的问题和许多类似的事情。

segments.en: Yeah, I think they're really useful because sometimes you prepare your presentation, you feel really good about it, but those questions at the end can be scary because you don't really know how to answer a question properly in English, or you don't know how to anticipate a question that you might get from the crowd.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为它们真的很有用，因为有时你准备好你的演示文稿，你感觉很好，但最后这些问题可能很可怕，因为你真的不知道如何用英语正确回答问题，或者你不知道如何预测你可能会从人群中得到的问题。

segments.en: So those are things that we would like to talk about in the next couple of episodes.
segments.zh: 所以这些是我们想在接下来的几集中讨论的事情。

segments.en: That's right, and remember that these phrases and how you see him presenting this laptop computer, you can still take a lot of the words, a lot of the vocab, a lot of the phrases and kind of put it into your speech or your presentation.
segments.zh: 没错，请记住，这些短语，以及他展示这台笔记本电脑的方式，你都可以把其中的很多单词、词汇和短语用到自己的演讲或演示中。

segments.en: You're going to sound great.
segments.zh: 你会听起来很棒。

segments.en: Absolutely.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: State of the art, save that one.
segments.zh: State of the art，这个一定要记下来。

segments.en: But that's about it for us here today at EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 但这就是我们今天在 Englishpod 的介绍。

segments.en: We hope you've enjoyed this lesson, and we will see you next time.
segments.zh: 我们希望您喜欢这节课，我们下次再见。

segments.en: All right, bye.
segments.zh: 好，再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
